notablePrerequisites:
Tawnos does not have summoning sickness.
"Green" chosen with Caged Sun.
You control at least two artifact tokens.
description:
Activate Tawnos' second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it, sacrificing two artifact tokens and exiling Tree of Tales from your graveyard, causing you to create a token of Tree of Tales.
When the Tree of Tales token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate the Tree of Tales token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Tawnos' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Tree of Tales token and causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.
